## Data and sources

This case uses station-to-station bicycle departures on **1 January 2026** from Divvy's January trip archive (`202601-trip-excerpt.csv`). The raw excerpt includes one next-day trip for the date-filter check.

Each retained record represents **one individual departure** (`flow = 1` in `trips`) with timestamps recorded in the `America/Chicago` timezone. Station coordinates are derived as the median of valid paired source coordinates per station on the selected day, and arrows represent directed station pairs rather than physical street trajectories.

Read the complete prepared day used for the dataset summary and later checks.

```{r read-prepared-day}
prepared_file <- "data/input.rds"
full_input <- readRDS(prepared_file)
```

```{r source-summary, echo=FALSE}
original_sources <- read.csv("data/original-sources.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
knitr::kable(
  original_sources[c("file", "provider", "role")],
  caption = "Original data sources",
  format = "html",
  row.names = FALSE
)

audit <- full_input$provenance
excluded_total <- sum(
  audit$missing_origin_only,
  audit$missing_destination_only,
  audit$missing_both,
  audit$unmatched_coordinates
)
within_station_total <- sum(
  full_input$flows$flow[full_input$flows$origin_id == full_input$flows$destination_id]
)

knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Item = c(
      "Source departures on selected day",
      "Located stations (nodes)",
      "Retained station-to-station trips (OD rows)",
      "Within-station trips",
      "Excluded records (missing station ID or coordinates)",
      "Timezone",
      "OD unit"
    ),
    Value = c(
      audit$source_departures,
      nrow(full_input$nodes),
      nrow(full_input$flows),
      within_station_total,
      excluded_total,
      full_input$timezone,
      full_input$unit
    )
  ),
  caption = "Complete prepared dataset",
  format = "html",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

Departure clocks retain fractional seconds in `America/Chicago`. Omitted station pairs or timestamps are not filled with zero because a complete dyad-observation domain is not assumed.

The preparation goal is to filter the declared departure day, validate unique ride IDs and local clocks, construct a located station register, retain only trips whose two endpoints join that register, preserve within-station rides, optionally aggregate time or space without changing the trip total, and draw a descriptive directed OD map.

## Raw input and field meanings

### Inspect the raw trip excerpt

The source reader filters the archive excerpt to departures on `2026-01-01` and strips trailing ASCII spaces from the two station-name columns while keeping all other source values unchanged.

The source reader uses `divvy_fields` from `prepare.R` to identify the trip fields. The report uses `timezone` when parsing local departure times.

```{r read-raw}
raw_file <- "data/raw/202601-trip-excerpt.csv"
day_reference <- "data/trips-2026-01-01.csv"
day <- "2026-01-01"
timezone <- "America/Chicago"

original_day <- read_divvy_source(raw_file, day = day, fields = divvy_fields)
raw <- clean_divvy_station_names(original_day, divvy_fields)
head(raw[c("ride_id", "started_at", "start_station_id", "end_station_id", "start_lat", "start_lng")])
```

```{r raw-field-description, echo=FALSE}
raw_dictionary <- data.frame(
  Source_field = c(
    "ride_id",
    "started_at, ended_at",
    "start_station_id, end_station_id",
    "start_station_name, end_station_name",
    "start_lat, start_lng, end_lat, end_lng",
    "rideable_type, member_casual"
  ),
  Meaning = c(
    "Unique source ride identifier",
    "Local departure and arrival timestamps in America/Chicago",
    "Origin and destination station identifiers (kept as text)",
    "Station names (trailing ASCII spaces removed)",
    "Origin and destination coordinates reported with each trip",
    "Vehicle type and rider membership category"
  ),
  Standard_destination = c(
    "Retained as flows$ride_id in individual-departure OD tables",
    "started_at becomes flows$time; ended_at stays in source CSV",
    "Mapped to flows$origin_id and flows$destination_id, joining nodes$node_id",
    "Most frequent nonblank name per station becomes nodes$display_name",
    "Median valid coordinate pair per station becomes nodes longitude/latitude",
    "Retained in the daily CSV; no extra map metric inferred"
  ),
  check.names = FALSE
)
names(raw_dictionary) <- c("Source field", "Meaning", "Standard destination")
knitr::kable(raw_dictionary, caption = "Raw trip field definitions", format = "html", row.names = FALSE)
```

The preprocessing also records how many rows are selected by date and how many station-name entries had trailing spaces removed.

```{r show-cleaning, echo=FALSE}
archive <- as.data.frame(
  data.table::fread(raw_file, colClasses = "character", na.strings = "", strip.white = FALSE, showProgress = FALSE)
)
name_fields <- unname(divvy_fields[c("origin_name", "destination_name")])
changed_names <- vapply(
  name_fields,
  function(field) sum(original_day[[field]] != raw[[field]], na.rm = TRUE),
  0L
)

cleaning_summary <- data.frame(
  Stage = c(
    "Original archive excerpt rows",
    "Selected 2026-01-01 departure rows",
    "Excluded next-day rows",
    "Trimmed start_station_name values",
    "Trimmed end_station_name values"
  ),
  Count = c(
    nrow(archive),
    nrow(raw),
    nrow(archive) - nrow(raw),
    unname(changed_names[1]),
    unname(changed_names[2])
  )
)
knitr::kable(cleaning_summary, caption = "Date selection and station-name cleaning summary", format = "html", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r source-rows-2, include=FALSE}
cleaned_day <- raw
```

```{r source-rows-3, include=FALSE}
name_fields <- unname(divvy_fields[c("origin_name", "destination_name")])
unchanged_fields <- setdiff(names(original_day), name_fields)
changed_names <- vapply(name_fields, function(field) sum(original_day[[field]] != cleaned_day[[field]],
    na.rm = TRUE), 0L)
stopifnot(identical(unname(changed_names), c(13L, 11L)), identical(original_day[unchanged_fields], cleaned_day[unchanged_fields]))
name_examples <- do.call(rbind, lapply(name_fields, function(field) {
    at <- which(!is.na(original_day[[field]]) & original_day[[field]] != cleaned_day[[field]])[1]
    data.frame(field = field, original = encodeString(original_day[[field]][at], quote = "\""), daily_csv = encodeString(cleaned_day[[field]][at],
        quote = "\""))
}))
day_directory <- tempfile("original-day-")
dir.create(day_directory)
day_file <- file.path(day_directory, "trips-2026-01-01.csv")
```

```{r source-rows-4, include=FALSE}
extract_divvy_day(raw_file, day_file, day = day, fields = divvy_fields)
raw <- as.data.frame(data.table::fread(day_file, colClasses = "character", na.strings = "", showProgress = FALSE))
```

```{r source-rows-5, include=FALSE}
fixture_files <- c(raw_file, day_file)
expected_day <- as.data.frame(data.table::fread(day_reference, colClasses = "character", na.strings = "",
    showProgress = FALSE))
stopifnot(identical(raw, cleaned_day), identical(raw, expected_day), identical(raw[unchanged_fields],
    original_day[unchanged_fields]), nrow(raw) == 1950L, ncol(raw) == 13L)
```


The day CSV retains all 13 source columns. Exact readback checks confirm the selected records and every field outside the two cleaned name columns.

### Deliberately invalid input and correction

Each retained ride ID must be unique. The following in-memory copy repeats the first ride ID but changes a non-mapped descriptive field, so it is not an exact duplicate and must be rejected. The source CSV is unchanged.

```{r invalid-input, echo=FALSE}
bad_raw <- rbind(raw, raw[1, ])
bad_raw$member_casual[nrow(bad_raw)] <- paste0(bad_raw$member_casual[nrow(bad_raw)], "_duplicate")
cat(tryCatch(
  {
    ride_input(
      bad_raw,
      day = day,
      timezone = timezone,
      fields = divvy_fields
    )
    "No error was raised."
  },
  error = conditionMessage
))
```

The corrected input is the cleaned, date-filtered `raw` table. Records lacking an identified and located origin or destination are excluded with explicit reason counts; they are not converted into zero-flow dyads.

## Prepare the OD-specific input

Raw trip files vary across bike-share and transit providers, so the source-specific helper `ride_input()` is used as an adapter to reconcile station coordinates, filter incomplete records, and produce the `nodes` station register and `flows` departure table used by the OD plotting interface.

### Prepare `nodes` and `flows` tables

Pass the cleaned day of trips to `ride_input()` and extract the resulting station register and individual departures.

```{r prepare-canonical-tables}
adapter_output <- ride_input(
  raw,
  day = day,
  timezone = timezone,
  fields = divvy_fields
)

nodes <- adapter_output[["nodes"]]
flows <- adapter_output[["flows"]]
```

```{r corrected-input-check, echo=FALSE}
data.frame(
  source_departures = adapter_output$provenance$source_departures,
  retained_trips = adapter_output$provenance$retained_trips,
  unique_ride_ids = !anyDuplicated(adapter_output$flows$ride_id),
  endpoint_references_valid = all(
    adapter_output$flows$origin_id %in% adapter_output$nodes$node_id &
      adapter_output$flows$destination_id %in% adapter_output$nodes$node_id
  )
)
```

Once these tables exist, collect them with the OD unit, time interpretation, timezone, and source provenance in a plain named list:

### Collect the OD tables and metadata

```{r construct-standard-input}
standard <- list(
  nodes = nodes,
  flows = flows,
  unit = "trips",
  timezone = timezone,
  time_kind = adapter_output[["time_kind"]],
  provenance = adapter_output[["provenance"]],
  title = "Divvy station departures",
  description = "Individual directed station-to-station departures on the selected source day.",
  preparation = c(
    "Filter the declared local departure day and validate unique ride IDs.",
    "Build station coordinates from medians of valid paired endpoint coordinates.",
    "Retain trips only when both station IDs join the located node register.",
    "Keep within-station rides in OD totals while excluding them from arrow drawing."
  )
)
```

The result is a plain named OD list. It contains `nodes`, `flows`, `unit`, `timezone`, `time_kind`, and descriptive source metadata. `interval_seconds` is included only for interval counts. Station names, generated indices, ride IDs, coordinates, and precise departure instants remain in their tables.

### What does `standard` contain?

```{r standard-structure, include=FALSE}
str(standard, max.level = 1, give.attr = FALSE)
```

The two main tables in the result are `nodes` and `flows`.

```{r show-standard, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(
  head(standard$nodes),
  caption = "Standard station nodes table (first six rows)",
  format = "html",
  row.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(
  head(standard$flows),
  caption = "Standard individual OD table (first six rows)",
  format = "html",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

The source-specific preprocessing creates the tables below and retains their auxiliary station and trip attributes. The plotting adapter used later reads a copy of the required fields:

- **Station register (`nodes`):** 512 located stations receive unique `node_id` values, zero-based `node_idx` indices, representative `display_name` labels, and median `longitude`/`latitude` coordinates;
- **Trip reconciliation (`flows`):** 720 departures missing an origin ID (186), destination ID (288), or both (246) are excluded and logged in provenance, leaving 1,230 complete station-to-station departures (including 85 within-station rides);
- **Time and flow:** each departure timestamp is parsed in `America/Chicago` (`time_kind = "instant"`) with `flow = 1` trip per ride;
- **Metadata:** timezone, trip unit, time interpretation, and reconciliation provenance are retained with the OD tables. Coordinates use longitude and latitude in EPSG:4326.

There is no explicit table of every possible station pair at every instant. Therefore, an absent OD record means **not supplied**, not an observed zero. A zero can only be claimed when the eligible dyad and observation interval have been defined and observed completely.

The OD representation keeps a station table and a directed trip table. Each `origin_id` and `destination_id` joins `nodes$node_id` to obtain endpoint coordinates. It does not use the road renderer's time-by-road matrix; each retained departure keeps its source time and trip count.

```{r standard-metadata, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Field = c("timezone", "time_kind", "unit"),
    Value = c(
      standard$timezone,
      standard$time_kind,
      standard$unit
    )
  ),
  caption = "Key standard-object metadata",
  format = "html",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

### Group stations before preparing the map

The map uses the spatially grouped day. The hourly station totals in the comparison table are a separate result, with the worked example in the appendix.

```{r derived-od, include=FALSE}
hourly_seconds <- 3600L
hourly_input <- ride_input(
  raw,
  day = day,
  timezone = timezone,
  bin_seconds = hourly_seconds,
  fields = divvy_fields
)
```

```{r spatial-od}
aggregation_radius_m <- 1500
spatial_prepared_file <- "data/spatial-1500m/input.rds"

spatial_input <- spatial_od_input(standard, radius_m = aggregation_radius_m)
spatial_input$provenance$preparation_sources <- data.frame(
  file = basename(raw_file), bytes = unname(file.info(raw_file)$size),
  sha256 = digest::digest(raw_file, file = TRUE, algo = "sha256", serialize = FALSE)
)
spatial_reference <- readRDS(spatial_prepared_file)
if (identical(spatial_reference$provenance$display_radius_m, as.numeric(aggregation_radius_m))) {
  stopifnot(identical(spatial_input$nodes, spatial_reference$nodes),
            identical(spatial_input$flows, spatial_reference$flows))
}
spatial_metadata <- spatial_input$provenance$spatial_aggregation
spatial_membership <- as.data.frame(spatial_metadata$membership)
```

```{r hourly-checks, include=FALSE}
hourly_input$provenance$time_aggregation <- list(
  method = 'Sum of retained departures by local hour and directed station pair.',
  interval_seconds = hourly_seconds, boundary = '[start, start + interval_seconds)',
  source_date = day, timezone = timezone)
source_hour <- format(standard$flows$time, '%Y-%m-%d %H', tz = timezone)
hour_counts <- aggregate(list(flow = standard$flows$flow),
  list(hour = source_hour, origin_id = standard$flows$origin_id,
       destination_id = standard$flows$destination_id), sum)
expected_hour_counts <- setNames(hour_counts$flow,
  paste(hour_counts$hour, hour_counts$origin_id, hour_counts$destination_id))
actual_hour_counts <- setNames(hourly_input$flows$flow,
  paste(format(hourly_input$flows$time, '%Y-%m-%d %H', tz = timezone),
        hourly_input$flows$origin_id, hourly_input$flows$destination_id))
stopifnot(identical(hourly_input$nodes, standard$nodes),
  setequal(names(expected_hour_counts), names(actual_hour_counts)),
  all(expected_hour_counts[names(actual_hour_counts)] == actual_hour_counts),
  sum(hourly_input$flows$flow) == sum(standard$flows$flow),
  hourly_input$time_kind == 'interval_start',
  hourly_input$interval_seconds == hourly_seconds,
  all(format(hourly_input$flows$time, '%M:%S', tz = timezone) == '00:00'),
  !anyDuplicated(hourly_input$flows[c('time', 'origin_id', 'destination_id')]))
example_row <- if (any(hourly_input$flows$flow > 1)) which(hourly_input$flows$flow > 1)[1] else 1L
hour_example <- hourly_input$flows[example_row, c('time', 'origin_id', 'destination_id', 'flow')]
example_start <- as.numeric(hour_example$time)
selected_departures <- standard$flows$origin_id == hour_example$origin_id &
  standard$flows$destination_id == hour_example$destination_id &
  as.numeric(standard$flows$time) >= example_start &
  as.numeric(standard$flows$time) < example_start + hourly_seconds
trip_example <- standard$flows[selected_departures,
  c('ride_id', 'time', 'origin_id', 'destination_id', 'flow')]
stopifnot(sum(trip_example$flow) == hour_example$flow)
trip_display <- trip_example
trip_display$time <- format(trip_display$time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%OS6', tz = timezone)
```

The example assigns each station to its nearest representative. The radius bounds station-to-representative distance. Each group uses the existing coordinates of its representative, and departures keep their original times.

```{r spatial-checks, echo=FALSE}
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(spatial_membership$raw_node_id),
  setequal(spatial_membership$raw_node_id, standard$nodes$node_id),
  all(spatial_membership$aggregate_node_id %in% spatial_input$nodes$node_id),
  all(spatial_membership$distance_to_representative_m <= aggregation_radius_m + 0.0005),
  spatial_metadata$max_assignment_distance_m <= aggregation_radius_m + 1e-7,
  sum(spatial_input$nodes$raw_node_count) == nrow(standard$nodes),
  sum(spatial_input$flows$flow) == sum(standard$flows$flow),
  spatial_input$time_kind == standard$time_kind,
  is.null(spatial_input$interval_seconds))
member_map <- setNames(spatial_membership$aggregate_node_id, spatial_membership$raw_node_id)
expected_spatial <- aggregate(list(flow = standard$flows$flow),
  list(time = as.numeric(standard$flows$time),
       origin_id = unname(member_map[standard$flows$origin_id]),
       destination_id = unname(member_map[standard$flows$destination_id])), sum)
expected_spatial_counts <- setNames(expected_spatial$flow,
  paste(sprintf('%.17g', expected_spatial$time), expected_spatial$origin_id, expected_spatial$destination_id))
actual_spatial_counts <- setNames(spatial_input$flows$flow,
  paste(sprintf('%.17g', as.numeric(spatial_input$flows$time)), spatial_input$flows$origin_id, spatial_input$flows$destination_id))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(names(expected_spatial_counts)), !anyDuplicated(names(actual_spatial_counts)),
  setequal(names(expected_spatial_counts), names(actual_spatial_counts)),
  all(expected_spatial_counts[names(actual_spatial_counts)] == actual_spatial_counts))
source_loops <- sum(standard$flows$flow[standard$flows$origin_id == standard$flows$destination_id])
spatial_loops <- sum(spatial_input$flows$flow[spatial_input$flows$origin_id == spatial_input$flows$destination_id])
stopifnot(spatial_loops >= source_loops)
```


Trip totals are preserved. Some trips between different stations become within-group trips. Records with the same departure time and grouped directed pair are summed.

```{r show-derived-summary, echo=FALSE}
derived_summary <- data.frame(
  Representation = c(
    "Individual station departures",
    sprintf("Hourly station OD (%s s)", format(hourly_seconds, big.mark = ",")),
    sprintf("Spatially grouped OD (%s m radius)", format(aggregation_radius_m, big.mark = ","))
  ),
  Nodes = c(
    nrow(standard$nodes),
    nrow(hourly_input$nodes),
    nrow(spatial_input$nodes)
  ),
  OD_records = c(
    nrow(standard$flows),
    nrow(hourly_input$flows),
    nrow(spatial_input$flows)
  ),
  Total_trips = c(
    sum(standard$flows$flow),
    sum(hourly_input$flows$flow),
    sum(spatial_input$flows$flow)
  ),
  Within_node_trips = c(
    sum(standard$flows$flow[standard$flows$origin_id == standard$flows$destination_id]),
    sum(hourly_input$flows$flow[hourly_input$flows$origin_id == hourly_input$flows$destination_id]),
    sum(spatial_input$flows$flow[spatial_input$flows$origin_id == spatial_input$flows$destination_id])
  ),
  check.names = FALSE
)
names(derived_summary) <- c("Representation", "Nodes", "OD records", "Total trips", "Within-node trips")
knitr::kable(derived_summary, caption = "Comparison of primary and aggregated OD representations", format = "html", row.names = FALSE)
```

<div class="note">Individual departures, hourly station totals, and spatial groups each use a plain OD list with <code>nodes</code> and <code>flows</code>. Their <code>time_kind</code> distinguishes instants from interval counts; hourly output also declares <code>interval_seconds</code>. Spatial membership remains in provenance.</div>

## Prepare the map window and draw the OD input

### Draw the bundled window

In a fresh R session with this example's directory as the working directory, load the bundled package and read the supplied 00:00–03:00 window and pass it directly to the plotter.

```r
source("../../bdynets/inst/preparation-session.R")
preparation_session(getwd())
library(bdynets)
pairs <- readRDS("data/spatial-1500m/window-0000-0300.rds")
traffic_od_map(pairs, basemap = NULL)
```

### Prepare a different window

Set the local start and end times in the preparation step below. It selects departures in `[start, end)`, sums trips by directed pair, attaches endpoint coordinates and retains within-group trips separately. It passes the read-back `bdynets_od_pairs` object to the map.

```{r prepare-map-input}
window_start <- "00:00"
window_end <- "03:00"
spatial_window_file <- "data/spatial-1500m/window-0000-0300.rds"

window <- divvy_window_times(day, window_start, window_end, timezone)
prepared_window <- divvy_window_input(spatial_input, window$start_time, window$end_time)
map_input_file <- tempfile("divvy-map-input-", fileext = ".rds")
saveRDS(prepared_window, map_input_file)
window_pairs <- readRDS(map_input_file)
stopifnot(identical(window_pairs, prepared_window))
reference_window <- readRDS(spatial_window_file)
if (identical(window_pairs$start_time, reference_window$start_time) &&
    identical(window_pairs$end_time, reference_window$end_time) &&
    identical(window_pairs$display_radius_m, reference_window$display_radius_m)) {
  fields <- c("nodes", "routes", "totals", "selected_flow", "within_node_flow")
  stopifnot(identical(window_pairs[fields], reference_window[fields]))
}
```

```{r map-display-time, include=FALSE}
start_text <- format(window_pairs$start_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tz = window_pairs$timezone)
end_text <- format(window_pairs$end_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tz = window_pairs$timezone)
end_on_same_day <- substr(start_text, 1L, 10L) == substr(end_text, 1L, 10L)
window_label <- paste(start_text, "to", if (end_on_same_day) substr(end_text, 12L, 16L) else end_text,
                      "|", window_pairs$timezone)
map_title <- paste("Divvy departures aggregated within", window_pairs$display_radius_m / 1000, "km")
```

### Grouped OD map

```{r od-map, fig.width=5.2, fig.height=8.4, out.width="72%", fig.alt="Departures between station groups in the prepared map window."}
map <- traffic_od_map(
  window_pairs,
  padding = 0.08,
  basemap = if (params[["basemap"]])
    list(mode = "auto", cache_dir = "data/basemap-cache", offline = TRUE) else NULL,
  flow_style = list(
    breaks = 1:6,
    labels = c(as.character(1:6), ">= 7"),
    palette = c("#16a43a", "#7ad151", "#f7ea2a", "#ffc928",
                "#f5a623", "#f36b2b", "#f01818"),
    right = TRUE
  ),
  title = map_title,
  subtitle = window_label,
  caption = "Directed OD counts. Curved arrows do not identify travel paths."
)
```

```{r map-summary, echo=FALSE}
window_summary <- data.frame(
  Original_station_nodes = nrow(full_input$nodes),
  Grouped_nodes = nrow(spatial_input$nodes),
  Selected_trips = map$summary[["selected_flow"]],
  Within_group_trips = map$summary[["within_node_flow"]],
  Displayed_directed_pairs = map$summary[["displayed_pairs"]],
  Displayed_nonloop_trips = map$summary[["displayed_flow"]],
  check.names = FALSE
)
names(window_summary) <- c(
  "Original station nodes", paste("Grouped nodes", paste0("(", window_pairs$display_radius_m / 1000, " km)")), "Selected trips",
  "Within-group trips", "Displayed directed pairs", "Displayed nonloop trips"
)
knitr::kable(window_summary, caption = paste("Grouped OD summary for", window_label), format = "html", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Validate the conversion

Validation is performed after the main workflow. The checks verify date filtering, agreement between the converted object and the prepared `input.rds` file, endpoint referential integrity, trip conservation across temporal and spatial aggregations, and source-file protection.

```{r validation, echo=FALSE}
validation <- data.frame(
  Check = c(
    "Date filtering retains 1,950 records on 2026-01-01",
    "Converted nodes and OD tables agree with the prepared day file",
    "Retained OD row count equals retained trips in provenance",
    "Ride IDs are nonblank and unique",
    "All OD endpoints exist in the station nodes table",
    "Hourly and spatial aggregations conserve total retained trips",
    "Spatial grouping does not reduce within-node trip totals",
    "The 1.5 km display aggregation conserves all retained trips",
    "The 1.5 km display aggregation reduces the node count",
    "Selected half-open window totals reconcile",
    "Source files remain unchanged during report generation"
  ),
  Passed = c(
    nrow(raw) == 1950L && ncol(raw) == 13L,
    isTRUE(all.equal(standard$nodes, full_input$nodes, check.attributes = FALSE)) &&
      isTRUE(all.equal(standard$flows, full_input$flows, check.attributes = FALSE)),
    nrow(full_input$flows) == full_input$provenance$retained_trips && sum(full_input$flows$flow) == full_input$provenance$retained_trips,
    !anyNA(full_input$flows$ride_id) && all(nzchar(full_input$flows$ride_id)) && !anyDuplicated(full_input$flows$ride_id),
    all(full_input$flows$origin_id %in% full_input$nodes$node_id) && all(full_input$flows$destination_id %in% full_input$nodes$node_id),
    sum(hourly_input$flows$flow) == sum(full_input$flows$flow) && sum(spatial_input$flows$flow) == sum(full_input$flows$flow),
    sum(spatial_input$flows$flow[spatial_input$flows$origin_id == spatial_input$flows$destination_id]) >= within_station_total,
    sum(spatial_input$flows$flow) == sum(full_input$flows$flow),
    nrow(spatial_input$nodes) < nrow(full_input$nodes),
    map$summary$selected_flow == map$summary$within_node_flow + map$summary$nonloop_flow,
    identical(source_before, tools::md5sum(source_files))
  )
)
knitr::kable(validation, caption = "Core validation results", format = "html", row.names = FALSE)

coverage <- data.frame(
  `Source departures` = full_input$provenance$source_departures,
  `Located stations` = nrow(full_input$nodes),
  `Retained trips` = nrow(full_input$flows),
  `Within-station trips` = within_station_total,
  `Missing origin only` = full_input$provenance$missing_origin_only,
  `Missing destination only` = full_input$provenance$missing_destination_only,
  `Missing both endpoints` = full_input$provenance$missing_both,
  `Unmatched coordinates` = full_input$provenance$unmatched_coordinates,
  Unit = full_input$unit,
  check.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(coverage, caption = "Complete-data coverage", format = "html", row.names = FALSE)
```

<div class="result">Every validation row must be <code>TRUE</code>. The 1.5 km grouping preserves every trip but changes the display nodes and increases within-group trips. The map reports these loops separately because they have no directional arrow between distinct groups.</div>

## Reproduce the report

From the bundle root, regenerate this report without background streets.

```bash
Rscript examples/DivvyBike/run.R --offline
```

`basemap=FALSE` omits background streets. With `basemap=TRUE`, the report uses a matching verified cache. A new map extent needs a matching OpenStreetMap cache acquired separately before rendering with the backdrop. OD nodes, routes, totals, validation, and exports do not depend on a basemap.

Common problems include a missing required column, duplicate ride IDs, an invalid or ambiguous local timestamp, an endpoint without a located station, a non-IANA timezone, a time bin that does not divide an hour, and reuse of an existing export directory. A missing OD row is not automatically an observed zero.

From the same root, use `prepare.R` to save a different ready-to-draw window to a new directory.

```bash
Rscript examples/DivvyBike/prepare.R --start 01:00 --end 02:00 divvy-0100-0200
```

Read `divvy-0100-0200/spatial-1500m/window-0100-0200.rds` for that window. Use the Rmd's `export` parameter when rendering it directly to keep the figure export. The `run.R` command renders the report and accepts `--offline`.

## Appendix {.unnumbered}

### Hourly station OD {.unnumbered}

```{r show-hourly-preparation, ref.label='derived-od', eval=FALSE}
```

Hourly station OD sums the retained departures by interval and directed station pair. The default intervals last one hour in `America/Chicago` and include the start but exclude the end.

```{r hourly-worked-example, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(trip_display, caption = 'Departures contributing to one hourly OD record',
             format = 'html', row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(hour_example, caption = 'The corresponding hourly OD record',
             format = 'html', row.names = FALSE)
```


Each row is a count for an interval and a directed pair. Original ride IDs remain in the day CSV. The station locations are unchanged, and absent hour–pair combinations are left unfilled.

The date remains part of each hourly timestamp. Pooling clock hours across dates would combine different dates and is a separate operation; the one-day example does not perform it.

### Station membership and groups {.unnumbered}

```{r spatial-membership-preview, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(head(spatial_membership), caption = 'Source stations and their representative groups',
             format = 'html', row.names = FALSE)
```

`raw_node_count` counts member stations, `member_weight` sums their unit station weights, and `endpoint_activity` counts departures plus arrivals at member stations. A within-node trip contributes two endpoints. Group IDs are representative source station IDs; `spatial_membership` retains every station's assignment and distance. A different radius defines different groups and within-group totals.

### Adapt a CSV with renamed columns {.unnumbered}

Another provider can use different headers as long as the user maps the same required roles.

```{r renamed-csv}
incoming <- raw
incoming_fields <- c(
  ride = "trip_key",
  departure = "departure_local",
  origin = "from_station",
  destination = "to_station",
  origin_name = "from_name",
  destination_name = "to_name",
  origin_lat = "from_latitude",
  origin_lon = "from_longitude",
  destination_lat = "to_latitude",
  destination_lon = "to_longitude"
)
names(incoming)[match(unname(divvy_fields), names(incoming))] <- unname(incoming_fields)

mapped_input <- ride_input(
  incoming,
  day = day,
  timezone = timezone,
  fields = incoming_fields
)
stopifnot(
  identical(mapped_input$nodes, standard$nodes),
  identical(mapped_input$flows, standard$flows)
)
head(incoming[unname(incoming_fields[c("ride", "departure", "origin", "destination")])])
```

Only the mapping changes; ride identity, timestamps, endpoints, missingness, units, and the OD input format do not.

### Export, read back, and reuse {.unnumbered}

`write_traffic_input()` publishes the teaching `standard` object to a new directory with RDS and CSV tables, a data dictionary, validation records, source identities, metadata, and checksums.

```{r prepared-export}
prepared_export_dir <- tempfile("divvy-prepared-export-")
dictionary <- read.csv("data/data-dictionary.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dictionary_key <- paste(dictionary$table, dictionary$field, sep = "/")
standard_key <- c(
  paste("nodes", names(standard$nodes), sep = "/"),
  paste("flows", names(standard$flows), sep = "/")
)
dictionary <- dictionary[dictionary_key %in% standard_key, ]

prepared_path <- write_traffic_input(
  standard,
  prepared_export_dir,
  source_files = raw_file,
  native = raw,
  dictionary = dictionary
)
restored <- readRDS(prepared_path)
```

```{r prepared-export-checks, echo=FALSE}

exported_flows <- read.csv(

  )
)

core_fields <- setdiff(names(standard), "provenance")
export_checks <- data.frame(

    "Dictionary and validation files are present",
    "Prepared-export checksums agree",
    "Source files remain unchanged"
  ),
  Passed = c(
    all(vapply(core_fields, function(key) identical(restored[[key]], standard[[key]]), logical(1))),
    identical(exported_flows$ride_id, standard$flows$ride_id) &&
      identical(exported_flows$origin_id, standard$flows$origin_id) &&
```

#### Derived-data export and readback {.unnumbered}

```{r derived-export-setup, echo=FALSE}
hourly_dictionary <- read.csv('data/data-dictionary.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)[c('table', 'field', 'meaning')]
hourly_dictionary <- hourly_dictionary[vapply(seq_len(nrow(hourly_dictionary)), function(i) {
  table <- hourly_dictionary[["table"]][i]; field <- hourly_dictionary[["field"]][i]
  table %in% names(hourly_input) && is.data.frame(hourly_input[[table]]) && field %in% names(hourly_input[[table]])
}, logical(1)), ]
hourly_dictionary[["meaning"]][hourly_dictionary[["table"]] == 'flows' & hourly_dictionary[["field"]] == 'time'] <-
  'Local hour interval start; the interval width and timezone are recorded in metadata.'
hourly_dictionary[["meaning"]][hourly_dictionary[["table"]] == 'flows' & hourly_dictionary[["field"]] == 'flow'] <-
  'Retained trips for this hour and directed source station pair.'
spatial_dictionary <- data.frame(table = c(rep('nodes', 4), rep('flows', 2)),
  field = c('display_name', 'raw_node_count', 'member_weight', 'endpoint_activity', 'time', 'flow'),
  meaning = c('Recorded name of the representative source station.', 'Number of source stations in this group.',
    'Sum of unit source-station weights; separate from trip counts.',
    'Departures plus arrivals at member stations; a within-node trip contributes two endpoints.',
    'Retained departure instant, with the source timezone recorded in metadata.',
    'Trips at this departure instant and grouped directed endpoint pair.'))

hourly_validation <- data.frame(
  check = c('Retained trips conserved', 'Unique hourly OD keys', 'Source station register preserved'),
  observed = c(sum(hourly_input[["flows"]][["flow"]]), sum(duplicated(hourly_input[["flows"]][c('time', 'origin_id', 'destination_id')])), nrow(hourly_input[["nodes"]])),
  expected = c(sum(standard[["flows"]][["flow"]]), 0, nrow(standard[["nodes"]])),
  passed = c(sum(hourly_input[["flows"]][["flow"]]) == sum(standard[["flows"]][["flow"]]),
    !anyDuplicated(hourly_input[["flows"]][c('time', 'origin_id', 'destination_id')]),
    identical(hourly_input[["nodes"]], standard[["nodes"]])),
  detail = c('The same retained departures are counted by local hour and directed station pair.',
    'Each hour and directed station pair occurs once.', 'Station fields and ordering remain unchanged.'))
spatial_validation <- data.frame(
  check = c('Retained trips conserved', 'Every source station assigned once', 'Representative radius bound', 'Time and grouped OD counts preserved'),
  observed = c(sum(spatial_input[["flows"]][["flow"]]), nrow(spatial_membership), spatial_metadata[["max_assignment_distance_m"]], length(actual_spatial_counts)),
  expected = c(sum(standard[["flows"]][["flow"]]), nrow(standard[["nodes"]]), aggregation_radius_m, length(expected_spatial_counts)),
  passed = c(sum(spatial_input[["flows"]][["flow"]]) == sum(standard[["flows"]][["flow"]]),
    !anyDuplicated(spatial_membership[["raw_node_id"]]) && setequal(spatial_membership[["raw_node_id"]], standard[["nodes"]][["node_id"]]),
    spatial_metadata[["max_assignment_distance_m"]] <= aggregation_radius_m + 1e-7,
    setequal(names(expected_spatial_counts), names(actual_spatial_counts)) &&
      all(expected_spatial_counts[names(actual_spatial_counts)] == actual_spatial_counts)),
  detail = c('Spatial grouping uses the same retained departures.',
    'Membership preserves every source station and its representative.',

    'No departure time is binned; only identical time and grouped endpoints are summed.'))
```

```{r derived-readback, echo=FALSE}
derivative_checks <- data.frame(representation = character(), check = character(), passed = logical())
for (name in c('hourly', 'spatial')) {
  expected <- if (name == 'hourly') hourly_input else spatial_input
  path <- if (name == 'hourly') hourly_path else spatial_path
  restored_derivative <- readRDS(path)
  for (key in setdiff(names(expected), 'provenance')) stopifnot(identical(restored_derivative[[key]], expected[[key]]))
  for (key in setdiff(names(expected$provenance), 'preparation_sources'))
    stopifnot(identical(restored_derivative$provenance[[key]], expected$provenance[[key]]))
  derivative_metadata <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(dirname(path), 'metadata.json'), simplifyVector = TRUE)
  stopifnot(derivative_metadata$timezone == expected$timezone,
    derivative_metadata$unit == expected$unit,
    derivative_metadata$time_kind == expected$time_kind,
    identical(as.numeric(derivative_metadata$interval_seconds), as.numeric(expected$interval_seconds)))
  for (table in c('nodes', 'flows')) {
    expected_table <- expected[[table]]
    classes <- vapply(expected_table, function(value) {
      if (inherits(value, 'POSIXct') || is.double(value)) 'numeric'
      else if (is.integer(value)) 'integer' else if (is.logical(value)) 'logical' else 'character'
    }, '')
    actual_table <- as.data.frame(data.table::fread(file.path(dirname(path), paste0(table, '.csv')),
      colClasses = classes, na.strings = derivative_metadata$csv$missing, showProgress = FALSE, check.names = FALSE))
    stopifnot(identical(names(actual_table), names(expected_table)), nrow(actual_table) == nrow(expected_table))
    for (field in names(expected_table)) {
      a <- actual_table[[field]]; b <- expected_table[[field]]
      if (inherits(b, 'POSIXct') || is.numeric(b)) stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(as.numeric(a), as.numeric(b), tolerance = .Machine$double.eps)))
      else stopifnot(identical(a, b))
      stopifnot(identical(is.na(a), is.na(b)))
    }
  }
  manifest_derivative <- read.csv(file.path(dirname(path), 'checksums.csv'))
  stopifnot(identical(unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(dirname(path), manifest_derivative$file))), manifest_derivative$md5))
  derivative_checks <- rbind(derivative_checks, data.frame(representation = name,
    check = c('Trip total retained', 'RDS and typed CSV readback', 'Export checksums'),
    passed = c(sum(expected$flows$flow) == sum(standard$flows$flow), TRUE, TRUE)))
}
restored_membership <- as.data.frame(data.table::fread(membership_file,
  colClasses = c(raw_node_id = 'character', aggregate_node_id = 'character', distance_to_representative_m = 'numeric'),
  showProgress = FALSE))
stopifnot(identical(restored_membership, spatial_membership),
  identical(readRDS(spatial_path)$provenance$spatial_aggregation$membership, spatial_membership))
json_membership <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(dirname(spatial_path), 'metadata.json'), simplifyVector = TRUE)$provenance$spatial_aggregation$membership
stopifnot(identical(as.data.frame(json_membership), spatial_membership))
derivative_checks <- rbind(derivative_checks, data.frame(representation = 'spatial',
  check = c('Complete unique membership', 'Membership CSV and metadata readback'),
  passed = c(nrow(spatial_membership) == nrow(standard$nodes) && !anyDuplicated(spatial_membership$raw_node_id), TRUE)))
stopifnot(all(derivative_checks$passed), identical(source_before, tools::md5sum(source_files)))
knitr::kable(data.frame(representation = c('hourly', 'spatial'),
  data = c('hourly/input.rds', 'spatial/input.rds'),
  readable_tables = c('hourly/nodes.csv; hourly/flows.csv', 'spatial/nodes.csv; spatial/flows.csv; membership.csv'),
  timing = c('interval_start: 3600 seconds', 'original departure instants')),
  caption = 'Separate reusable derived outputs', format = 'html', row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(derivative_checks, caption = 'Derived-data validation and readback',
             format = 'html', row.names = FALSE)
```



RDS readback preserves IDs, timestamps, values, timing metadata and membership exactly. Typed CSV readback checks the same table values and missingness. Each export also includes `data-dictionary.csv`, `validation.csv`, `metadata.json`, `source-files.csv` and `checksums.csv`. The membership CSV retains station IDs, group IDs and distances to representatives. Source files and the primary standard input are unchanged.

#### OD-specific figure and window export {.unnumbered}

Road examples can use `traffic_export()`, but this example has no road-flow layer. The export passes the same prepared OD input to `traffic_od_map()` for PNG and PDF. It records the prepared routes, nodes, bounds and provenance alongside the rendered summary, session information and checksums.

```{r od-export-function}
export_od_window <- function(output_dir) {
  if (file.exists(output_dir)) stop("Choose a new OD export directory.")
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

  result <- NULL
  for (extension in c("png", "pdf")) {
    current <- traffic_od_map(
      window_pairs,
      basemap = if (params[["basemap"]])
        list(mode = "auto", cache_dir = "data/basemap-cache", offline = TRUE) else NULL,
      flow_style = list(
        breaks = 1:6,
        labels = c(as.character(1:6), ">= 7"),
        palette = c("#16a43a", "#7ad151", "#f7ea2a", "#ffc928",
                    "#f5a623", "#f36b2b", "#f01818"),
        right = TRUE
      ),
      title = map_title,
      subtitle = window_label,
      caption = "Directed OD counts; curved arrows are not observed paths.",
      width = 5.2, height = 8.4,
      output_file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("od-map.", extension)),
      draw = FALSE
    )
    if (is.null(result)) result <- current
  }

  exported_input <- window_pairs
  exported_input$schema <- "bdynets-od-window-v1"
  exported_input$summary <- result$summary
  saveRDS(exported_input, file.path(output_dir, "selected-window.rds"), compress = "xz")
  write.csv(window_pairs$nodes, file.path(output_dir, "selected-nodes.csv"), row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  write.csv(window_pairs$routes, file.path(output_dir, "selected-routes.csv"), row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  jsonlite::write_json(
    list(
      schema = "bdynets-od-window-v1",
      selection = list(
        start_time = start_text,
        end_time = end_text,
        interval = "half-open [start, end)",
        timezone = window_pairs$timezone,
        loops_drawn = FALSE,
        display_radius_m = window_pairs$display_radius_m
      ),
      summary = result$summary,
      source = window_pairs$provenance
    ),
    file.path(output_dir, "provenance.json"),
    auto_unbox = TRUE,
    pretty = TRUE,
    null = "null",
    na = "null"
  )
  writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(output_dir, "session-info.txt"))
  files <- sort(list.files(output_dir))
  write.csv(
    data.frame(
      file = files,
      bytes = unname(file.info(file.path(output_dir, files))$size),
      md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(output_dir, files)))
    ),
    file.path(output_dir, "checksums.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  invisible(result)
}
```


```{r reproducibility, echo=FALSE}
)
revision <- digest::digest(
  paste(paste(bundle_files, bundle_sha, sep = " "), collapse = "\n"),
  algo = "sha256",
  serialize = FALSE
)

cat("Package version:", as.character(packageVersion("bdynets")), "\n")
cat("Bundled source revision (SHA-256):", revision, "\n")
cat("Report computation elapsed:", round(proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - render_started, 1), "seconds\n")
sessionInfo()
```
